source: Round-28 second live e2e dispatch on T-11. With the round-28 builder.md verify-command derivation rule in place, the subagent constructed the CORRECT verify command (`pnpm exec vitest run src/features/incidents/components/StopButton.test.tsx`) — finding #2 from round 27 fixed cleanly. But the subagent still emitted `verify_fail` after 3 attempts despite the final code state passing all tests (independently verified: 3/3 pass, tsc clean, lint clean). New finding (round 28 #3): subagent counts intermediate TDD-cycle test failures (RED phase) as verify_fail attempts and emits verify_fail without re-running the verify after the final refactor. Methodology fix shipped this PR: builder.md TDD step 7 now explicitly requires a final verify re-run before constructing the exit payload.

actual_baseline.notes: Subagent's code is correct AND its verify command is correct. The verify_fail is a false negative — the final code state passes 3/3 tests when run via the exact command the subagent reported. Hypothesis: subagent confused intermediate RED-phase failures with verify-gate failures, and emitted verify_fail without re-running verify on the final post-refactor state. Round-28 builder.md amendment (TDD step 7) explicitly addresses this. Validation requires another live re-dispatch — not in this PR to keep cost bounded; tracked as a follow-up.

notes: Companion to `regression-round-27-T11-verify-fail-vitest-jest-confusion`. Together the pair traces the methodology evolution: round 27 found the verify-command-construction gap (fixed in this PR's first commit), round 28 found the false-negative-attempt-counting gap (fixed in this PR's third commit). Both required real subagent runs to surface. The validation re-dispatch (T-11 attempt 3) is a follow-up; if it succeeds with `status: success` and a real commit, slice 1 advances to 6/11 and the third companion case captures the success baseline.
